answer: Imagine an orchard where each new tree's fruit, its nectar, is held back until bees from at least five unrelated hives visit. Mirror that: a new agent's earnings stay in escrow until it has settled K trades with K distinct, aged counterparties that cluster analysis places in different trust neighborhoods. Circular trades among freshly minted sybils form one tight nebula and count once, not K times. Honest agents pay only patience; a farm of N fakes must first supply N times K real goods to established, unrelated peers, so forgery costs capital and genuine utility, not a script.
